mixed_325.note: mixed radix [3,2,5]; parametrised rxy/rz — NOT round-trip identical, see defects.D2

two_regs.note: two named registers; gates across them; creg is one flat `meas`

qubits_default.note: no dimensions given → every wire is 2; `cx` is emitted WITH four params (an embedded two-level gate)

bare_qreg_input.origin: hand-written (MQT never emits the bare form)
bare_qreg_input.note: `qreg matter [2];` = TWO qudits of dimension 2 (qasm.py parse_qreg: `qdims = [2] * nq`)

bare_qreg_reemitted.origin: mqt.qudits QuantumCircuit.to_qasm() of the parsed bare_qreg_input
bare_qreg_reemitted.note: what MQT writes back for the bare form: `[2][2,2]` plus its auto-appended measures

ctl_hand_corrected.origin: hand-written (ctl_writer_defect with the control indices corrected by hand)
ctl_hand_corrected.note: level list after `ctl` pairs POSITIONALLY with the control-qudit list: q[0]→level 2, q[2]→level 1

defects.D1: to_qasm() writes the TARGET index for every control: `h q[1] ctl q[1] q[1] [2, 1];` for controls [0, 2]. from_qasm() of its own output raises IndexError('Controls overlap with targets').
defects.D2: from_qasm() drops the parameters of `rxy`/`rz`: the parser hands a tuple, the gate's validate_parameter accepts only a list, so `_params` is None and re-emission writes `rxy q[0];`. `cx` keeps its four params through the same path.

header_lock: parse_ditqasm2_str header regex is `(DITQASM\s+2.0;)|(include\s+"qelib1.inc";)`: `DITQASM 3.0;`, `DITQASM 2.1;` and `OPENQASM 2.0;` are SyntaxError.
